easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mercurial Pretender
description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Mercurial Pretender into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mercurial Pretender's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Mercurial Pretender's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Mercurial Pretender's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.
